newsitem.title: UK: BBC launches 24-hour FM radio service for Qatar.
newsitem.headline: BBC launches 24-hour FM radio service for Qatar.

text.p: The BBC is to launch a new round-the-clock FM radio service in Qatar on December 21, its World Service said on Friday.
The service, the first of its kind in the Arab world, will include programmes in Arabic and English and will broadcast via a direct satellite link from London.

"I am delighted that the citizens of Qatar now have an alternative to shortwave and will be able to switch on the radio and listen to the BBC in high quality FM 24 hours a day," said the World Service's managing director Sam Younger.
Sheikh Hamad bin Thamer Al-Thani, Qatar's Under-Secretary for Information said as part of the deal, the BBC will train a number of senior Qatari broadcasters.
The BBC Arabic service was launched in 1938 and was the first non-English service to be set up by the BBC.
